method: Unchanged original classes on the MobMoveProbe world double (stone below y 0, air above) extended to record spawned entities, level events and explosions. The models and renderers (bin, bpc, bpd) are bytecode-derived and are not run. Post-invulnerability xc.bn (target selection, head cadence, block breaking) and xc.e (flight) call the full EntityMob stack and are bytecode-derived (javap -c -p xc), not run; launch, skull, spawn countdown, head positions, hurt rejections, drops and NBT are run.
